name: StillDrawn
description: StillDrawn asks whether an inked comic or manga panel still looks drawn after an image-to-video model animates it. This record archives the benchmark: 29 inked panels controlled for content class and ink treatment, plus 5 ground-value variants, each with its line-art layer and generation recipe (full for 27 panels; described, not reproducible, for 2); all 373 clips generated by five image-to-video engines (and a sixth in a scout study) under a pre-registered protocol, with a per-clip manifest and metric outputs; the frame strips behind the failure-mode taxonomy; the frozen pre-registration and its amendments; the budget ledger; pseudonymised human-check ratings with the rating instrument; and the metric, harness and analysis code. Files: stilldrawn-dataset (panels, line art, recipes, datasheet); stilldrawn-clips- (one archive per engine, stored uncompressed and byte-exact); stilldrawn-results (manifest, metrics, analysis outputs, human check, documents); stilldrawn-code (MIT-licensed code; paper source under CC BY 4.0). Start with dataset/DATASHEET.md inside stilldrawn-dataset. All content is machine-generated. Some items were produced through commercial services whose terms restrict using outputs to build competing products; see NOTICE-PROVIDERS.md (inside stilldrawn-dataset), which is informational and does not modify the licence. Please do not use the items it lists to train generative models.
